note: Bundled fallback for the TTS relay list. The app reads this file when fetching the online manifest fails — which is the normal case for users in mainland China, because the manifest host (updates.supercrzy.com) sits behind the same cross-border link that makes direct Edge-TTS handshakes take 1.5-30s. Shipping it inside the package means the relay is usable on first launch with no network round-trip. Keep in sync with updates.supercrzy.com/releases/tts-relays.json.
